meanings.usage: 指正式场合的宴会或聚会
表达对某人的尊敬和赞赏
指人的幽默性格或幽默的东西
指在公共场合的正式发言
修饰动词，表示做事的仔细程度
表达因期望落空而产生的情绪
表示从某事中获得乐趣
表示因感到有趣而发出笑声

meanings.meaning: type 种类，有特殊特征的

phrases.usage: 指拥有很多的社交圈子，朋友很多

examples.en: He has a large circle of friends.

phrases.usage: 发表演讲，在公共场合进行正式发言

examples.en: He was asked to make a speech at the wedding.
examples.zh: 他被邀请在婚礼上发表演讲。

phrases.usage: 令他惊讶的是，表示出乎意料

examples.en: To his surprise, she refused the invitation.
examples.zh: 令他惊讶的是，她拒绝了邀请。

phrases.usage: 一...就...，表示两个动作紧接着发生

examples.en: As soon as he finished, Jenny left.

phrases.usage: 这类事情，某种类型的事物

examples.en: This is the sort of thing that he loves.
He did as his daughter asked.
examples.zh: 他按照女儿的要求做了。

examples.en: They talked on the way home.
examples.zh: 他们在回家的路上交谈。

phrases.usage: 大量的，许多的，后接可数名词复数

examples.en: He told a large number of funny stories.
examples.zh: 他讲了很多有趣的故事。

examples.en: Of course, it was a great success.
examples.zh: 当然，这是一次巨大的成功。

examples.en: He was a little disappointed by this.
examples.zh: 他对这件事感到有点失望。

grammar.title: 直接引语和间接引语（Direct and Indirect Speech）
grammar.structure: 主句 + 连词 + 主语 + 动词 + 其他成分；人称变化：第一人称→第二人称，第二人称→第一人称；时态后退（过去时→过去完成时等）
grammar.definition: 当转述别人的话时，可以使用直接引用原话，或将原话转换为转述句。间接引语中，人称、时态、时间状语等通常需要相应变化。 用于转述他人说过的话，使叙述更加流畅自然。在口语和书面语中都常用。

examples.en: She said she hadn't enjoyed the speech.
examples.zh: 她说她不喜欢那个演讲。

examples.en: He asked her why she hadn't enjoyed it.
She told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him.
examples.zh: 她告诉他她不喜欢看到那么多人在笑他。

grammar.title: as soon as 的用法
grammar.structure: as soon as + 主语 + 动词...，主句
grammar.definition: 连词词组，表示'一...就...'，强调两个动作紧接着发生。 用于描述先后发生的两个动作，第一个动作一发生，第二个动作立即开始。常用于叙述故事的发展。

examples.en: As soon as he had finished, Jenny told him she wanted to go home.
examples.zh: 他一讲完，Jenny就告诉他她想回家。

examples.en: As soon as I arrived, I called my mother.
examples.zh: 我一到达就给我妈妈打了电话。

grammar.title: 过去完成时（Past Perfect Tense）
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作或状态。由had + 过去分词构成。 用于描述过去的过去，即两个过去的动作中，先发生的动作用过去完成时。当after, as soon as等连词引导时间状语从句时，主句用过去完成时，从句用一般过去时。

examples.en: As soon as he had finished, Jenny told him...
He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech.
examples.zh: 他在演讲中加入了大量有趣的故事。

patterns.pattern: Everybody admires him for his + 名词

original.en: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour.
original.zh: 每个人都钦佩他的幽默感。

imitations.en: Everybody admires her for her kindness.
imitations.zh: 每个人都钦佩她的善良。

imitations.en: We admire him for his courage.

patterns.pattern: To his + 情绪名词, she + 动词过去式

original.en: To his surprise, she said she hadn't.
original.zh: 令他惊讶的是，她说她没有（喜欢）。

imitations.en: To his disappointment, he failed the exam.
imitations.zh: 令他失望的是，他考试不及格。

imitations.en: To her surprise, everyone agreed with her.
imitations.zh: 令她惊讶的是，每个人都同意她的观点。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + asked + 宾语 + if/why/what + 陈述句/疑问句

original.en: He asked her why this was so.

imitations.en: She asked him if he was tired.
They asked me why I was late.

patterns.pattern: This is the sort of thing that + 主语 + loves/hates

original.en: This is the sort of thing that Jeremy loves.

imitations.en: This is the sort of thing that she hates.
That is the sort of book that I enjoy.
imitations.zh: 那正是我喜欢的那种书。

lines.en: Jeremy Hampden has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties.
lines.zh: 杰里米。汉普登交际甚广，是各种聚会上深受大家欢迎的人。

lines.en: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour -- everybody, that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny.
lines.zh: 人人都钦佩他那绝妙的幽默感--人人，就是说，除他6岁的女儿珍妮之外的每一个人。

lines.en: Recently, one of Jeremy's closest friends asked him to make a speech at a wedding reception.
lines.zh: 最近，杰里米的一个最亲密的朋友请他在一个婚礼上祝词。

lines.en: This is the sort of thing that Jeremy loves.
lines.zh: 这正是杰里米喜欢做的事情。

lines.en: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.
lines.zh: 他认真准备了讲稿，带着珍妮一道去参加了婚礼。

lines.en: he had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success.
lines.zh: 他的祝词里面加进了大量逗人的故事，自然大获成功。

lines.en: As soon as he had finished, Jenny told him she wanted to go home.
lines.zh: 他刚一讲完，珍妮就对他说她要回家。

lines.en: Jeremy was a little disappointed by this but he did as his daughter asked.
lines.zh: 这不免使杰里米有点扫兴，但他还是按照女儿的要求做了。

lines.en: On the way home, he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.
lines.zh: 在回家的路上，他问珍妮是否喜欢他的祝词。

lines.en: To his surprise, she said she hadn't.
lines.zh: 使他吃惊的是，她说她不喜欢。

lines.en: Jeremy asked her why this was so and she told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him!
lines.zh: 杰里米问他为何不喜欢，她说她不愿意看到那么多的人嘲笑他！

questions.q: Why did Jenny want to leave the wedding reception?
questions.zh: 珍妮为什么想在婚礼招待会上离开？
questions.a: Because she did not like to see so many people laughing at her father.
questions.aZh: 因为她不愿意看到那么多人嘲笑她爸爸。

questions.q: Why is Jeremy so popular at parties?
questions.zh: 为什么杰里米在聚会上这么受欢迎？
questions.a: Because he has a great sense of humour and everybody admires him for it.
questions.aZh: 因为他有绝妙的幽默感，人人都为此钦佩他。

questions.q: How did Jeremy feel when Jenny asked to go home, and what did he do?
questions.zh: 珍妮提出要回家时，杰里米作何感受？他怎么做了？
questions.a: He was a little disappointed, but he did as his daughter asked.
questions.aZh: 他有点扫兴，但还是按女儿的要求做了。
questions.hint: 见 Jeremy was a little disappointed by this but he did as his daughter asked。

questions.q: What does 'this was so' refer to in 'Jeremy asked her why this was so'?
questions.a: It refers to the fact that Jenny had not enjoyed the speech.
questions.aZh: 指珍妮不喜欢他那篇祝词这件事。
questions.hint: this 回指上句 she said she hadn't。

questions.q: Why did the guests laugh while Jenny felt sorry for her father?
questions.zh: 为什么宾客大笑，珍妮却替爸爸难过？
questions.a: The guests knew the funny stories were meant to amuse them, so they laughed with Jeremy; Jenny, only six, took the laughter as laughing at her father. Humour depends on shared understanding.
questions.aZh: 宾客明白笑话是用来逗乐的，所以跟着杰里米一起笑；六岁的珍妮却把笑声理解成嘲笑爸爸。可见幽默依赖共同的理解。
questions.hint: 对比 it was a great success 与末句。

translation:
杰里米。
汉普登交际甚广，是各种聚会上深受大家欢迎的人。
人人都钦佩他那绝妙的幽默感--人人，就是说，除他6岁的女儿珍妮之外的每一个人。
最近，杰里米的一个最亲密的朋友请他在一个婚礼上祝词。
这正是杰里米喜欢做的事情。
他认真准备了讲稿，带着珍妮一道去参加了婚礼。
他的祝词里面加进了大量逗人的故事，自然大获成功。
他刚一讲完，珍妮就对他说她要回家。
这不免使杰里米有点扫兴，但他还是按照女儿的要求做了。
在回家的路上，他问珍妮是否喜欢他的祝词。
使他吃惊的是，她说她不喜欢。
杰里米问他为何不喜欢，她说她不愿意看到那么多的人嘲笑他！
title: She was not amused
subtitle: 她并不觉得好笑

lead.question: 人人都夸杰里米有幽默感，为何他六岁的女儿却一点也不觉得好笑？
lead.warmup: 杰里米·汉普登交游甚广，聚会上人缘极好，人人都钦佩他绝妙的幽默感——只有他六岁的女儿珍妮例外。最近一位密友请他在婚宴上致辞，他精心准备了讲稿，还塞进大量笑话，果然大获成功。可他刚一讲完，珍妮就吵着要回家。回家路上父亲追问缘由，答案出人意料：她不喜欢看到那么多人嘲笑爸爸。
goals: 掌握 a large circle of friends、be popular at parties、admire sb. for sth.、a sense of humour 等搭配
掌握 make a speech at a wedding reception、the sort of thing、to one's surprise、laugh at
巩固间接引语：陈述句用 said/told (that)，一般疑问句用 asked if 并时态后退
辨别 six-year-old 类复合形容词与插入语 that is，理解 as 引导的方式状语从句
lead.summary: 本课以一则小笑话串起三组真功夫：一是名词与固定短语——a large circle of friends、be popular at、admire sb. for、a (great) sense of humour、the sort of thing、make a speech at a wedding reception、to one's surprise、laugh at；二是复合形容词 six-year-old 与插入语 that is；三是间接引语。
lead.tips: 转述疑问句时语序必须还原为陈述句，且时态随 asked 后退一格：Did you enjoy the speech? → he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech。

exercises.q: 按课文填空：Jeremy has a large ______ of friends and is very popular ______ parties.
介词填空：Everybody admires him ______ his great sense ______ humour.
用复合形容词改写：He has a daughter. She is six years old. → He has a ______ daughter.
完成句子：Recently one of Jeremy's closest friends asked him __ __ __ __ at a wedding reception.（请他在婚宴上致辞）
把直接引语改为间接引语：Did you enjoy the speech? Jeremy asked Jenny.
exercises.a: Jeremy asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.

exercises.q: 用 I wonder 改写：Where is he?
exercises.note: wonder 后接疑问词，仍用陈述语序。

exercises.q: 转述祈使句：Don't worry about it, he said to me.
exercises.a: He told me not to worry about it.

quiz.q: 人人都钦佩他那绝妙的幽默感，正确英文是？
options: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour.
Everybody admires him of his great sense of humour.
Everybody admires him with his great sense of humour.
Everybody admires him for his great sense of funny.

quiz.q: 请他在一个婚礼招待会上致辞，正确表达是？
options: asked him to make a speech at a wedding reception
asked him make a speech at a wedding reception
asked him to make speech at a wedding reception
asked him to make a speech on a wedding reception

quiz.q: 下列哪句中 sort 的用法与课文 the sort of thing 相同？
options: I don't like that sort of joke.
He was sort of disappointed by her answer.
She sorted the guests into two rooms.
The sort of very funny stories.

quiz.q: “Did you enjoy the speech?” Jeremy asked Jenny. 的间接引语是？
options: Jeremy asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.
Jeremy asked Jenny did she enjoy the speech.
Jeremy asked Jenny if had she enjoyed the speech.
Jeremy asked Jenny that she had enjoyed the speech.
quiz.note: asked if 后必须还原陈述语序。

quiz.q: 她告诉他，她不愿意看到那么多人嘲笑他，正确英文是？
options: She told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him.
She told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing to him.
She told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at her.
She said him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him.

quiz.q: 使他吃惊的是，正确的英文短语是？
options: To his surprise
For his surprise
In his surprise
At his surprise
